semantics.queue_rule: Per-subscription delivery buffering has explicit size/age/rate bounds.
semantics.ack_rule: Acknowledgment semantics are explicit and distinguish delivered from accepted/processed where needed.
semantics.cursor_rule: Cursor advances according to explicit acknowledgment profile, not merely network send.
semantics.pause_rule: Pause stops new active delivery while preserving explicit resume position/profile.
semantics.resume_rule: Resume begins from exact accepted cursor/watermark evidence.
semantics.replay_rule: Replay uses exact change identities and is bounded/idempotent.
semantics.overflow_rule: Queue overflow policy is explicit: block, drop-with-evidence, fail, resnapshot or other declared policy.
semantics.authorization_rule: Resume/replay rechecks applicable current subscription/source governance.
semantics.failure_rule: Lost/overflowed range is surfaced explicitly and never represented as complete.

invariants.rule: DWH changefeeds expose committed mutation evidence as ordered provenance-bearing data/events; subscription delivery never directly executes downstream operations and never replaces the underlying record/revision identities.

hard_gates.condition: cursor advances on send when ack required

references.purpose: Backpressure state belongs to exact subscription runtime.
